description: TY2026: the NEW $7,500 IRA limit (Notice 2025-67 — up from $7,000; stale-knowledge trap). Single, $60,000 wages, NOT covered by an employer plan, contributes $8,000 -> deduction capped at the $7,500 limit (no phase-out for non-participants; excess-contribution excise not modeled, disclosed). TI = 60,000 - 7,500 - 16,100 = 36,400 -> Tax Table midpoint 36,425: 1,240 + 12%x24,025 = 2,883 -> $4,123. Net $4,123.00.
